preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each edge (u, v) satisfies 1 <= u, v <= n and u != v
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the tree.

preconditions.expression: The input defines a valid tree
preconditions.description: The input graph is a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.

postconditions.expression: The output contains an integer paths
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the number of paths chosen by Noora.

postconditions.expression: Each path description contains integers and a real number
postconditions.description: Each subsequent line describes a path with its edges and the point's starting position and direction.

postconditions.expression: The paths are chosen to minimize res1
postconditions.description: The goal is to minimize the maximum time res1 at any vertex, then res2, and so on.

invariants.expression: Each vertex is part of at least one path
invariants.description: Every vertex in the tree must be included in at least one of the selected paths.

invariants.expression: Paths do not intersect in edges
invariants.description: The selected paths do not share any edges; they are disjoint.

invariants.expression: Points move according to the given rules
invariants.description: The points move along the edges of the paths as specified, starting from the given distances and moving towards the specified vertices.
